root_cause: Original verified Supabase cron job #177 runs at 00:18/06:18/12:18/18:18 UTC, but original bg-social-metrics-sync upserted only one provider-social-metrics:<Amsterdam-day> record into powerhouse_runtime_events each execution. Example 2026-11-12 has four succeeded cron job runs and only one last daily event at 18:18. This destroyed independent readback of earlier per-run statuses/evidence; a day summary is not an append-only event or original downstream metric/learning consumer ACK.
prevention_rule: Within the same original authorized Edge job #177 and existing powerhouse_runtime_events, record a distinct audited source execution under provider-social-metrics:run:<UUID> as event_type provider_social_metric_ingest_receipt, preserving true observed/error state, UTC six-hour slot and exact source outcome. Require an independently returned exact ID/status/evidence readback BEFORE updating existing provider-social-metrics:<Amsterdam-day> daily summary under its unchanged event_type. Distinct attempts have distinct receipts; never create a second cron, table, provider request, publication, metric, learning or fake consumer ACK. Do not treat healthy=true or HTTP 200 as evidence of 24/48/72h source-bound learning or revenue.
evidence: Read-only cron.job run details 2026-11-12T00:18,06:18,12:18,18:18 UTC, all succeeded; original provider event 'provider-social-metrics:2026-11-12' has only latest occurred_at 2026-11-12T18:18:25.4Z, no separate six-hour results.

Original bg-social-metrics-sync/index.ts used upsert({dedupe_key:'provider-social-metrics:'+day,...}) and event_type provider_social_metric_ingest; source event table has UNIQUE(dedupe_key), no separate original run ID.
Original social_learning_obligations 184 OPEN and 365 BRAIN CONTENT_HANDOFF OPEN; original Heartbeat 9 GREEN/6 RED. The source audit does not establish any extra provider metric/learning outcomes.
Original #171 and #177 are active; no second scheduler allowed. The new receipts are in the existing table and event type distinct to avoid double-counting daily consumer summaries.
risks: Adding audit events without original provider readback cannot prove actual missing historical results.
A successful source poll does not prove authentic time-bound post measurement, CRM conversion or applied learning.
Service-token and Vault access must remain unchanged; event receipts are accessible only to the original authorized writer.
